home.whyIntro: We are your travel advisors, not just another website. We combine the personal touch of a real person with the convenience of managing your trip online, so you can travel with confidence from beginning to end.
home.why1Body: When you contact us, you speak with an advisor who listens, understands what you are looking for, and puts together options for you. No automated system.
home.why2Body: Flights, hotels, packages, or a fully customized trip: we suggest alternatives based on your budget, dates, and what you dream of.
home.why3Body: With My reservation, you can check your booking, itinerary, documents, and payment status from anywhere, whenever you need.
home.why4Body: We do not disappear after you book. We support you before, during, and after your trip, and we are here to help if anything changes.
home.why5Body: We explain every detail: what is included, what is not, and how it works. No fine print. We confirm the final price with you before booking.
home.why6Body: Since 2018, we have helped Honduran travelers discover the world, drawing on our experience to help make their trips go well.

static.aboutTitle: We are your travel advisors, not just another website.
static.about1: At viatour, we believe planning a trip should not feel like fighting with a machine. Since 2018, we have accompanied Honduran travellers as they discover the world, first through Facebook and WhatsApp and now through this platform designed to make everything simpler.
static.about2: The difference is simple: when you write to us, you speak with a real person. Not an automated system or a form nobody reads. Someone who listens, understands what you are looking for and guides you toward the best decision for your trip, budget and time.
static.about3: We are advisors, not an impersonal search engine. That closeness lets us put together options tailored to you — flights, hotels, packages or a completely personalized trip — and explain every detail clearly, so you can travel with confidence and without complications.
static.about4: Our commitment is to make your experience comfortable, reliable and smooth, from your first question until you return home with a good story to tell.
